en: Hello, we expect {item} ({qty_ordered} {unit}) on {promised}. Please tell us the time of day. Our store takes deliveries between 7:00 and 16:00.
mt: 您好,我们预计将在3日开始.请告诉我们一天的时间.我们的商店在7点到16点之间接受交货.

en: Hello {vendor}, please send your best price for {qty} of {item}, delivered to our farm, with the lead time and how long the quote is valid. Your last quote was {price} per unit.
mt: 你好,请发送您最好的价格,送到我们的农场,带领时间和报价有效的时间.您的最后报价是 {price} 每个单位.

en: Hello, invoice {invoice} for {item} charges {price} per unit but our list price is {list_price}. Please check it and send a corrected invoice.
mt: 你好,发票 {invoice} 每单位收费 {price} 但我们的列表价格是 {list_price}. 请检查并发送一个纠正的发票.

en: Hello, batch {batch} of {item} expired on {expiry}. We hold {qty} {unit}. Can you take it back or tell us how to dispose of it safely?
mt: 您可以把它带回来,或者告诉我们如何安全地处置它吗?

en: Hello, please send a credit note for order {ord_id}. We received {qty_received} of {qty_ordered} {unit} of {item}, and the delivery was {days_late} days after the promised {promised}.
mt: 您好,请发送一个信用单. 我们收到 {qty_received} 的 {qty_ordered} {unit} 的 {item},和交付是 {days_late} 天后的 {promised} 承诺.

en: Hello, the fertiliser plan for {field} ({crop}, {area} ha) is ready: N {n_ha}, P2O5 {p_ha} and K2O {k_ha} kg per ha. Please check it before we order the fertiliser.
mt: 您好, {field} ({crop}, {area}公) 的肥料计划已经准备好了:每公 N {n_ha},P {area}O5}和K {area}O5}公斤.请在订购肥料之前检查.

en: Hello {operator}, spread {item} on {field} on {date}: {rate} kg per ha, {qty} kg in all. Please check the spreader setting and keep clear of water and boundaries.
mt: 请检查散布器设置,保持远离水和边界.

en: Hello {keeper}, we count {item} today. The sheet says {balance} {unit}. Please count what is on the shelves and write the number on the stock card.
mt: 你好,我们今天计算了1号.纸上写着2号.请计算货架上的东西,并在股票卡上写出号码.

en: Hello {supervisor}, please switch off irrigation on {field} when {hours_turn} hours are done. Write the hours in the log and close the valves.
mt: 您好,请在 {field} 结束 {hours_turn} 小时后关闭灌. 在日志中写出时间,并关闭门.

en: Hello, a fault was logged on {field} on {date}, and the run lasted {hours} hours. Please walk the line, repair the leak today and tell me when it is fixed.
mt: 您好,在 {date} 上出现了一个故障,运行持续了 {hours} 小时. 请走在线,今天修复泄漏并告诉我何时修复.

en: Hello {keeper}, please check the water level in {name}. The pump may run dry. We have used {used_m3} m3 this season, which is {share} of the quota.
mt: 您好,请检查水位. 可能会干燥. 我们本赛季使用了 {used_m3} m3,这是 {share} 的配额.
